title: Browns will make "evaluation" of quarterback position after Week 2

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Browns will make "evaluation" of quarterback position after Week 2
sources.description: When the Browns decided, two days after an all-time press-conference meltdown from Deshaun Watson, to make him the Week 1 starting quarterback, it immediately seemed to be a product of the fact that Cleveland starts the season with two games, you know, not in Cleveland.
